calls.statement:
WITH lines AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.quantity, f.staff_purchase_flag, f.etl_loaded_at,
         p.sku, p.subcategory AS subcat_asof, cp.subcategory AS subcat_current, p.category AS cat_asof, cp.category AS cat_current
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
  WHERE s.store_id = 107 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
)
SELECT
  count(*) AS line_rows, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS distinct_line_ids, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS distinct_receipt_lines,
  sum(CASE WHEN subcat_current = 'Cleaning Products' THEN quantity END) AS units_current,
  sum(CASE WHEN subcat_asof = 'Cleaning Products' THEN quantity END) AS units_asof,
  sum(CASE WHEN subcat_current = 'Cleaning Products' AND staff_purchase_flag THEN quantity END) AS staff_units,
  sum(CASE WHEN subcat_current = 'Cleaning Products' AND quantity <= 0 THEN 1 END) AS nonpositive_rows,
  count(CASE WHEN subcat_current = 'Cleaning Products' THEN 1 END) AS cp_rows,
  count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN subcat_current = 'Cleaning Products' THEN sales_line_id END) AS cp_distinct_ids,
  min(CASE WHEN subcat_current = 'Cleaning Products' THEN sale_date END) AS first_d, max(CASE WHEN subcat_current = 'Cleaning Products' THEN sale_date END) AS last_d,
  count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS load_stamps
FROM lines

calls.statement:
WITH mine AS (
  SELECT f.sale_date, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts, sum(f.quantity) AS units, sum(f.net_amount) AS net_before_returns,
         min(f.etl_loaded_at) AS first_load, max(f.etl_loaded_at) AS last_load
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id = 107 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT c.business_date, c.receipts AS rpt_receipts, m.receipts, c.units_sold AS rpt_units, m.units, c.net_sales_before_returns AS rpt_net, m.net_before_returns, m.first_load, m.last_load
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales c LEFT JOIN mine m ON m.sale_date = c.business_date
WHERE c.store_id = 107 AND c.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
ORDER BY 1

SELECT 'returns booked at Hyvinkaa in P05' AS what, sum(r.quantity_returned) AS units, count(*) AS rows
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE s.store_id = 107 AND cp.subcategory = 'Cleaning Products' AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'sales-line units sold (final)', sum(f.quantity), count(*)
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE s.store_id = 107 AND cp.category = 'Cleaning & Household' AND cp.subcategory = 'Cleaning Products' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'whole category Cleaning & Household units', sum(f.quantity), count(*)
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE s.store_id = 107 AND cp.category = 'Cleaning & Household' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
